title: Pure Icejade
summary: Icejade cards only, with generic WATER Extra Deck monsters and staples. Icejade is a WATER Aqua control deck that recycles itself. Acti, Tinola and Tremora each banish themselves from the GY to summon another Icejade whenever one of your WATER monsters is destroyed. Icejade Aegirine searches an Icejade Spell/Trap, and Icejade Cradle searches a monster. Icejade Cenote Enion Cradle shrinks their whole board each time a monster is summoned. Icejade Kosmochlor and Icejade Curse stop their freshly summoned monsters from using effects. Icejade Ran Aegirine, the newest card, is a Level 7 Tuner that summons itself with a Token and counts as Cenote Enion Cradle while equipped. Ran Aegirine and Aegirine make Icejade Gymir Aegirine, which protects your monsters and banishes their copies. Ran Aegirine's Token limits the Extra Deck to WATER monsters.
